body: PROVISIONAL D7/D9 RULING. The scheduler is a receipt-bearing DAG with five source-side phases: deterministic ingest; cheap full-source scan; source-only window nomination; bounded expensive interpretation; global deterministic resolution. Every requested extent ends as observed, examined-with-no-candidate, abstained/unsupported, failed, or not attempted. Selection criteria and analysis coverage are first-class artifacts. Primary scoring uses SourceFrozen mode: deleting or changing a held-out recall cannot alter the source artifact hash. Recall-conditioned work is allowed only as a separately named DiagnosticExpansion child artifact that cannot enter primary estimates, or as CrossFittedExpansion frozen before disjoint subjects or films are evaluated. D9 gates are estimand-specific, not one aggregate score: zero clock/evidence/identity law failures; transcript timing and wording accuracy with condition-stratified coverage; accepted speaker/character precision with calibrated abstention; direct-observation precision separated from inference; matched audiovisual-binding foils for wrong speaker, face, time, action, modality, and edition; narrative event, context, chronology, causality, and hierarchy accuracy; source-to-recall target, interval, granularity, fidelity, ordering, compression, omission, and external-state metrics; exact cache replay and provider-drift reports. The full audiovisual source must beat transcript-only, visual-only, audio-only, and one-shot omni baselines on predeclared modality-relevant subsets, not merely in an overall average. Re-encoding creates a different source identity; stability under re-encoding is an invariance benchmark through an explicit content-alignment claim, never hash equality. Runtime remains fully automatic: humans create gold, calibration, and release audits but never repair a production build. Required leakage court: rebuild the source twice with all held-out recall files deleted versus adversarially changed and require byte-identical accepted source artifacts. Required aggregate-metric trap: a system that assigns every nearby valid utterance/action to the dominant character may score well overall; matched principal/minor/off-screen/overlap cases and per-character macro metrics must reject it.
